prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT the supplied character concept sheet into a subtly more agile, lean version of the SAME protagonist. The user likes its existing tactile matte paper texture; preserve the quality, chalk ivory monochrome palette, charcoal background, rendering style and identity. Main requested change is silhouette and posture, not new costume or material. Reduce the head diameter about 15 percent relative to the body, keeping its round shape; narrow the torso about 20 percent and turn its bulbous pear belly into a slender gently tapered rounded rectangular torso. Modest graceful athletic proportions, still a small mysterious drawn being, not a tall human. Keep the same scale and margins of each whole figure on the sheet. Run pose has a purposeful forward torso angle, clear bent knees and elbows, confident longer stride rather than a toddler toddle. Consistent new proportions in ALL THREE poses. Retain exactly one small dark dot eye visible per head; no mouth, nose, eyebrows, ears, hair, horns, clothes, cloak, scarf, armor, accessories or weapons. Preserve gentle rounded contours, subtle paper-chalk surface relief and broad soft shading. Keep contour controlled and readable at 176px gameplay height. Do not add pointed shapes to convey agility. No spikes, sharp chin, angular head, extra face details, muscular anatomy, colored accents, intense glow, plastic shine, photorealism, pixel art, noisy scratches, excessive grain or extra figures. The change should feel like the same character became a little leaner and quicker, not a new species.
